about: IsoKron's own fixture servers for the writecheck loop worker (loop/run-items.mjs). A subject listed here runs at the exact npm version given, with the manifest in loop/fixtures/ instead of the generic catalog manifest, and, where full.plan_hash is set, a full write test against a disposable backend inside the sandbox. full.plan_hash is a hash a person read and accepted (here: the same hash dogfood-tiny-tracker.yml and dogfood-kronicle-lite.yml accept for the same server version, manifest and CLI); a plan that gives another hash is recorded as drift and the full run does not start. known_answer names the tiny-tracker defect the shard's known-answer control switches on. Change only by a reviewed commit.

kronicle-lite.subject: isokron-ai/kronicle-lite
setup:
set -e; mkdir -p /work/out/kl-data /work/out/kl-seed; printf '# Dogfood guard

This store belongs to one CI job and is thrown away after it.
' > /work/out/kl-seed/guard.md; printf '# Bystander one

Not created by the tester.
' > /work/out/kl-seed/by1.md; printf '# Bystander two

Also not created by the tester.
' > /work/out/kl-seed/by2.md; node "$1/dist/cli.js" put dogfood-guard /work/out/kl-seed/guard.md --title 'dogfood guard'; node "$1/dist/cli.js" put dogfood-bystander-1 /work/out/kl-seed/by1.md --title 'bystander one'; node "$1/dist/cli.js" put dogfood-bystander-2 /work/out/kl-seed/by2.md --title 'bystander two'
